current.text: He was traded from Toronto to the Clippers in the Kawhi Leonard trade.
He has a partially torn Achilles, found during surgery in May. He is out now.
Experts disagree on his return date. One expects him back in November, another around Christmas. No one knows what restrictions he will have when he returns.

Experts now fade him. He is not a top 100 pick and is fine only around picks 100 to 110 in stash-friendly formats. One expert calls him the biggest fade on the Clippers, and others will not draft him.
He went for 6 USD in an expert auction mock draft.
Once healthy, he is expected to be the Clippers' top option next to Darius Garland. His usage should rise from 26.7% and may get close to 30%.
His assists may not rise because Garland runs the offense.
The Clippers do not control their own draft pick, so tanking does not help them. Their motivation this season is unclear, and it may be a trial season with long rotations.
The Clippers play 4-3-4 games in our playoff weeks (season ending March 28). With 13 back-to-backs, they have one of the lowest totals in the league.

durable.text: Over five seasons he played 55, 45, 64, 18 and 77 games. His minutes stayed between 32.9 and 34.2.
He is injury-prone and a notoriously slow healer, so his games played are hard to project.
He is one of the better midrange scorers in the league. He needs a lot of the ball and is useless playing off the ball.
He rarely takes threes and has struggled with three-point volume and percentage.
He is an average defender at best, with poor defensive stats.
Turnovers are his weak category. At about 2.7 per game, he is weak for his position.

note: He cost 16 USD in our league last season. With a partially torn Achilles and a return date that experts place anywhere from November to Christmas, they now rank him outside the top 100. The Yahoo average cost of 3.2 USD and ESPN's 4 USD fit that view better than Yahoo's 16 USD value. With 4 IL slots, he is a fair late stash at a few dollars as a points scorer for a punt TO build, but do not pay near 16 USD. In November and December, check his return date and any minutes limit. If he is back by then, the Clippers' 4-3-4 playoff schedule helps.
